# OpenNexus 0.5.9-beta2

本次更新完善笔记引用定位、画布文件路径、批量重命名同步与聊天收尾，并将流式回复中的代码高亮移到后台。安装包包含 AI Core、WebView2 SDK Loader 和 Runtime 安装引导程序。

## 更新内容

- **正文链接与 AI 引用**：统一笔记路径，修复误报“文件已移动”；引用和搜索结果可在源码及可视化编辑器中定位、高亮对应段落，过期引用提供明确提示。
- **编辑与外部刷新**：保护文件读取、保存和切换期间的新增编辑；外部更新暂时读取失败或遇到保存操作时保留重试，恢复后继续核对正文。
- **文件身份与同步**：保留大小写改名、已删除目标名复用及批量重命名中的文件身份；按路径占用关系处理改名链和交换环，并在重启后继续未完成同步。
- **Canvas 文件路径**：支持文件名中的 `#`、`%` 及字面百分号编码，预览、打开、背景图片和反向链接按原始文件路径解析，节点标题定位单独处理。
- **聊天编辑、重生成与停止**：分支校验、上下文和响应预留保持原子性；停止或断开后正确结束未确认的聊天工具状态，保留结果和 Agent 链接。历史保存移到后台，完成提交后再报告生成结束，保存失败会提示。
- **Benchmark 增量持久化**：配置与数据集保存一次，逐样本追加证据并更新进度，减少重复序列化和写入，保留导出、对比、取消及重启恢复。
- **编辑器和回复预览高亮**：代码分词与预览 HTML 在 Worker 中计算；流式更新合并中间版本，先显示正文再补充颜色，复用未变化代码块，并丢弃过期结果。
- **GitHub Actions 与发布检查**：覆盖 Windows 文件监听、重命名身份和同步恢复，增加中英文发布说明、版本及下载链接的一致性检查。

性能测量与原生验证详见 [beta2 验证记录](https://github.com/KiriAky107/OpenNexus/blob/v0.5.9-beta2/frontend/docs/beta2-acceptance.md)。

## 下载

- [OpenNexus_0.5.9-beta2_x64-setup.exe](https://github.com/KiriAky107/OpenNexus/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta2/OpenNexus_0.5.9-beta2_x64-setup.exe)：Windows x64 桌面安装包，包含 AI Core。
- [OpenNexus_0.5.9-beta2_source.zip](https://github.com/KiriAky107/OpenNexus/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta2/OpenNexus_0.5.9-beta2_source.zip)：固定发布提交的源码快照。
- [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/KiriAky107/OpenNexus/releases/download/v0.5.9-beta2/SHA256SUMS.txt)：安装包与源码包的 SHA-256 校验清单。

下载后在 PowerShell 中校验安装包，并与清单中的对应值比较：

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\OpenNexus_0.5.9-beta2_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```

## English

This update improves note navigation, Canvas file paths, batch rename synchronization and chat finalization, and moves code highlighting in streamed replies into a background Worker. The installer includes AI Core, the WebView2 SDK Loader and the Runtime bootstrapper.

- **Note links and AI citations:** normalize note paths to prevent incorrect “file moved” warnings. Citations and search results locate and highlight the matching passage in both source and visual editors, with a clear notice for outdated references.
- **Editing and external refresh:** protect edits made during loading, saving and navigation. Retain pending external updates when a read temporarily fails or a save is in progress, and retry the body check afterward.
- **File identity and synchronization:** preserve identities across case changes, reuse of deleted names and batch renames. Order rename chains by path occupancy, handle cycles and resume unfinished synchronization after restarting.
- **Canvas file paths:** preserve literal `#`, `%` and percent sequences in filenames throughout previews, opening, background images and backlinks. Handle node heading targets separately from file paths.
- **Chat editing, regeneration and stopping:** prepare branches, context and response reservations atomically. End unconfirmed chat tool states on cancellation or disconnect while retaining results and Agent links. Save history in the background, report completion after commit and surface write failures.
- **Incremental benchmark persistence:** store configuration and datasets once, then append sample evidence and progress while retaining export, comparison, cancellation and restart recovery.
- **Editor and reply highlighting:** compute tokens and preview HTML in Workers. Coalesce streamed updates, display text before colors arrive, reuse unchanged blocks and discard obsolete results.
- **GitHub Actions and release checks:** cover Windows file watching, rename identity and sync recovery, and validate bilingual release notes, version consistency and download links.

See the [beta2 validation record](https://github.com/KiriAky107/OpenNexus/blob/v0.5.9-beta2/frontend/docs/beta2-acceptance.md) for measurements and native checks. Downloads above provide the Windows x64 installer, the source snapshot and SHA-256 checksums. Use the PowerShell command above to verify the installer against SHA256SUMS.txt.
